chunks: Jamil narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm if a man goes to Mecca, performs tawaf during the days of Mina, and does not stay overnight there.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ مِنًى: the days associated with staying in Mina during hajj
key_terms.فَيَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, circumambulation around the Ka'bah
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the sacred city visited for hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to go to Mecca for tawaf during the days of Mina without staying there overnight?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling concerning hajj rites and movement between Mina and Mecca. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that there is no harm in going to Mecca during the days of Mina for tawaf without spending the night in Mina.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3013 - Jamil narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"There is no harm if a man goes to Mecca, performs Tawaf during the days of Mina, and does not stay overnight there."
